The E. & A.s. "Arafura" left Manila for this port on June 10, with the outward Australian Mail and was dub here this morning.
The P. & O. a.e. "Kashmir" left Singapore for this port on June 7 at 6 a.m. with the outward English Malts and is due here to day.

The B.L.a.a. "Tilawa" left Singapore for this port on June 7 at p.m. and is and is due here to-morrow at about a.m.
The O.P.R.R.M.S.E. "Empress of Australia" Capt. A. J. Halley, E.R.R. Comm.ander, will leave here for Victoria and Vancouver, B.C., via Shanghai (Woosung), Rube and Yokohama at Noon to tomorrow.

The P. d O. s.s. "Kalyan" left Shanghai for this port on June 8, at 4 p.m. and is due to the tomorrow at about 6 a.m.
The B. F. s.s. "Ixion" for Genos, Havre. Liverpool and Glasgow left Rbanghai on June 8 for this port and is due here to day. The vessel will be despatched at noon tomorrow.

The C.P.J., R.M.S. "Empress of Asia," arrived at Nagasaki yesterday at 3 p.m. left Nagasaki today at 1 a.m. and is due at Shanghai tomorrow at 5 a.m. and will leave Shanghai on Saturday June 13 at 7 a.m.

The A.O.T. a.s. "Prez. Jackson" which sailed from this port at 5 p.m. on June 6, arrived at Manila at 9 a.m. on June 8. She returns from that port at 5 p.m. to-day arriving here at 9 a.m. on June 13 and will sail for Victoria and Seattle via Shanghai and Japan at 5 p.m. on June 14.
The C.P.S. R.W.S. "Empress of Russia" arrived at Yokohama on June 6 at p.m. left Yokohama on June 6 at p.m. and is due at Vancouver on June 15.
